     3	## Brand
     4	MedBook is an online healthcare appointment marketplace that connects patients with local doctors, dentists, and specialists for easy same-day booking. The platform empowers patients to search by specialty, location, and insurance, read verified reviews, and book appointments online in minutes — all completely free for patients. The tone is modern, professional, and playful, making healthcare access feel simple and approachable.

    13	Search bar placeholder: Search by condition, specialty, or doctor name
    14	Location field placeholder: City, state, or zip code
    15	Insurance field placeholder: Choose your insurance plan
    16

    18	The primary search interface includes three fields:
    19	- **Specialty / Condition / Doctor** — autocomplete text input with dropdown suggestions (e.g., "Dentist," "Back pain," "Dr. Sarah Chen")
    20	- **Location** — city, state, or zip code with geolocation auto-detect option
    21	- **Insurance** — dropdown selector with major insurance carriers (Aetna, Blue Cross, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, etc.)
    22	
    23	CTA Button: "Search"
    24	
    25	## Popular Specialties

    27	
    28	- **Primary Care** — Annual checkups, sick visits, and preventive care
    29	- **Dentist** — Cleanings, fillings, and oral health exams
    30	- **Dermatologist** — Skin conditions, acne, and cosmetic consultations
    31	- **Psychiatrist** — Mental health evaluations and medication management
    32	- **Eye Doctor** — Vision exams, glasses prescriptions, and eye health
    33	- **Orthopedic Surgeon** — Joint pain, fractures, and sports injuries
    34	
    35	Each card includes a specialty icon and label. Clicking a card triggers a filtered search for that specialty.
    36	
    37	## How It Works
    38	A three-step visual guide explaining the MedBook booking flow:
    39	
    40	1. **Search for a provider** — Enter your specialty, condition, or doctor name along with your location and insurance. Browse detailed provider profiles with photos, credentials, and office hours.
    41	2. **Choose a time that works for you** — View real-time availability and pick an appointment slot that fits your schedule — including same-day and next-day options.
    42	3. **Book your appointment instantly** — Confirm your visit in just a few clicks. Receive instant confirmation and reminders so you never miss an appointment.
    43

    46

    48	- **12,000+** healthcare providers nationwide
    49	- **Same-day** appointments available daily
    50	- **100% free** for patients — always
    51

    54	- "As someone new to the city, MedBook helped me find a primary care doctor who accepts my insurance in under five minutes. Highly recommend!" — **James T.**, Chicago, IL
    55	- "I was dreading finding a new dentist, but the verified reviews on MedBook gave me confidence. My appointment was exactly what I needed." — **Laura K.**, Austin, TX
    56	
    57	## Mobile App Promo
    58	Title: Your health, in your pocket
    59	Subtitle: Download the MedBook app to search for doctors, manage appointments, and get reminders — all on the go. Available on iOS and Android.
    60	CTA: "Download on the App Store" | "Get it on Google Play"
    61	
    62	Key app features:
    63	- Book and manage appointments anywhere
    64	- Get real-time appointment reminders
    65	- Access your visit history and provider details
    66	- Read and leave verified reviews
    67	
    68	## Header Navigation
    69	- Logo: MedBook (links to home)
    70	- Nav links: Browse · Help · Log In · Sign Up
    71	- Mobile: Hamburger menu icon toggles a slide-out drawer with Browse, Log In, and Sign Up
    72

    75	**For Providers:** List Your Practice · Provider Resources · Advertise with Us
    76	**Company:** About MedBook · Careers · Press · Blog · Contact Us
    77	**Legal:** Terms of Service · Privacy Policy · Accessibility · Do Not Sell My Info

    79	Tagline in footer: © 2024 MedBook, Inc. All rights reserved. MedBook is free for patients. Always.

    :root {
      --primary: #1B1464;
      --primary-light: #2d247a;
      --accent: #FFD930;
      --accent-hover: #e6c32b;
      --bg: #FFFFFF;
      --bg-alt: #F6F7F9;
      --text: #1B1464;
      --text-secondary: #5A5A7A;
      --text-muted: #8A8AA3;
      --border: #E2E4EA;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,20,100,0.06);
      --shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(27,20,100,0.08);
      --shadow-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(27,20,100,0.12);
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --max-width: 1200px;
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--bg);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    /* Header */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .header-inner {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }

    .logo {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--primary);
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .logo span {
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .nav-desktop {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .nav-desktop a {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .nav-desktop a:hover {
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .nav-desktop .btn {
      padding: 8px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .btn-outline {
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      border-color: var(--primary);
      background: var(--primary);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--accent-hover);
    }

    .menu-toggle {
      display: none;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
    }

    .menu-toggle svg {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      stroke: var(--primary);
    }

    /* Mobile Drawer */
    .mobile-drawer {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      right: -100%;
      width: 280px;
      height: 100vh;
      background: var(--bg);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      z-index: 200;
      padding: 80px 24px 24px;
      transition: right 0.3s ease;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .mobile-drawer.open {
      right: 0;
    }

    .mobile-drawer a {
      padding: 12px 0;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .mobile-drawer .btn {
      margin-top: 8px;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .drawer-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(27,20,100,0.3);
      z-index: 150;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.3s;
    }

    .drawer-overlay.open {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8f9fc 0%, #eef1f8 100%);
      padding: 80px 24px 100px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -100px;
      right: -100px;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;

    /* Autocomplete dropdown */

      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--text);

      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;

    .autocomplete-item:hover,

      background: var(--bg-alt);

    .autocomplete-item svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      stroke: var(--text-muted);

    /* Stats Bar */
    .stats-bar {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 40px 24px;

    .stats-inner {

      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);

    .specialty-card h3 {

      font-weight: 700;

    .specialty-card p {

    .steps-grid {

      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);

    .step-card {
      background: var(--bg);

      padding: 40px 32px;

    .step-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .step-number {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: var(--primary);
      border-radius: 50%;

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;

    .step-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--primary);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .step-card p {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* Testimonials */
    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
    }

    .testimonial-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }

    .testimonial-card .quote-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .testimonial-card .quote-icon svg {

      height: 100%;
      fill: var(--accent);

    }

    .testimonial-card blockquote {

      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 20px;

    }

    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .author-avatar {

      height: 40px;

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .author-info strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .author-info span {
      font-size: 0.875rem;

      font-size: 1rem;

      height: 20px;

    .app-buttons {

      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }

    .app-btn:hover {

    .app-btn svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;

    }

      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

      left: 50%;

      height: 20px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .phone-screen {
      position: absolute;
      top: 48px;
      left: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      bottom: 16px;
      background: var(--bg);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .phone-screen .mock-header {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--primary);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .phone-screen .mock-card {
      background: var(--bg-alt);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 12px;
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .phone-screen .mock-avatar {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;

      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-light));
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .phone-screen .mock-lines {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .phone-screen .mock-line {
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--border);
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

      width: 60%;
    }

    .phone-screen .mock-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: var(--primary);
      border-radius: 20px;
      font-size: 0.625rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      align-self: flex-start;
    }

    /* Footer */
    .footer {
      background: #0f0c3a;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      padding: 64px 24px 32px;

    .footer-inner {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .footer-brand .logo {
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .footer-brand p {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      max-width: 280px;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .footer-col a {
      display: block;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .footer-col a:hover {
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer-bottom p {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .specialties-grid,
      .testimonials-grid,
      .steps-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }

      .footer-brand {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-desktop {
        display: none;
      }

      .menu-toggle {
        display: block;
      }

      .hero {
        padding: 60px 20px 80px;
      }

      .search-bar {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 8px;
      }

      .search-field {
        min-width: 100%;
      }

      .search-bar .btn-search {
        width: 100%;
      }

      .stats-inner {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 24px 16px;
      }

      .specialties-grid,
      .testimonials-grid,
      .steps-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .app-promo-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .app-features li {
        justify-content: center;
      }

      .app-buttons {
        justify-content: center;
      }

      .app-promo-visual {
        order: -1;
      }

      .phone-mockup {
        width: 220px;
        height: 440px;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }

      .footer-bottom {
        flex-direction: column;
        text-align: center;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .stats-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 32px;
      }
    }
  </style>

        } else {
          item.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
